request.objective: Start at https://www.flightaware.com/. Find discussions of the community and open the one with the most replies of all time on Flightaware.

response.result: I couldn’t reliably identify and open FlightAware’s all-time discussion with the most replies. The all-time topic data I could access included “Tar1090 -- improved webinterface for dump1090-fa and readsb” with 1,045 replies, but the results were not shown to be a complete replies-sorted ranking. The visible ranking also showed a topic with 548 replies, but its title was not available in the retained page details. So I can’t establish which discussion is the all-time leader or say that it was opened.
